claim: A sharing account can have at most 250 pending invitations by default, and the quota is adjustable; it applies only to accounts sharing with accounts outside their AWS organization, a receiving account has no quota on pending invitations, and invitations are not used when sharing within an organization that has resource sharing turned on.

evidence.quote:
| Maximum number of pending invitations per sharing account + This quota applies to only **sending** accounts who are sharing with accounts that are not part of the same AWS Organizations.
+ There is no quota to limit how many pending invitations a receiving account can have.
+ Invitations are *not* used when sharing between accounts that are part of the same AWS Organizations and you've turned on resource sharing within the AWS Organizations. | 250 |
| Number of pending invitations | Each supported Region: 250 |  [Yes](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home/services/ram/quotas/L-238C96EE)  | The maximum number of pending invitations. |
